purpose: Select final B prospectively from identity-blind nuisance covariance without estimating or reporting named algorithm effects.
forbiddenInputs: named algorithm means, effect estimates, directions, ranks, weights, or winner
allowedDerivedQuantities: anonymous lane-level endpoint summaries needed only to estimate nuisance covariance
identity-blind design-matrix rank and cluster-robust covariance
opaque-target contrast standard errors and covariance
Monte Carlo power at the prospectively fixed MIPE
Wilson lower confidence bound for Monte Carlo power
runtime budget lookup for the selected B
outputSuppression: do not serialize endpoint means or target-versus-comparator observed contrasts
do not unseal, infer, or report real algorithm identities
do not interpret qualification quality or effectiveness
failClosed: Any forbidden field access, input hash mismatch, schema/cardinality/ordinal mismatch, non-finite quantity, rank failure, covariance failure, or inability to meet power causes a terminal fail-closed result without selecting or freezing B.
